name: smwsprites-diagonal-springboard-beans-v1
title: Diagonal Springboard/Beans v1.1
description:
Diagonal Green Beans - now with more settings

Made using the green beans disassembly by imamelia.

Extra bit sets the direction, if clear they'll be attached to left wall, if set they'll be attached to right wall.

Extra byte sets the diagonal direction, 00 is angled up, 01 is angled down.

V1.1 - Added number of bounces before they poof
- Second extra byte sets number of bounces
- Max 4 bounces, 0 means infinite, see ASM for settings
